definitions.gloss: parole; conditional release; early release from prison
definitions.explanation: The release of a prisoner before the completion of their sentence, subject to conditions and supervision.

examples.japanese: {受刑者|じゅけいしゃ}が{仮釈放|かりしゃくほう}された。
examples.english: The prisoner was released on parole.

examples.japanese: {仮釈放|かりしゃくほう}の{条件|じょうけん}に{違反|いはん}した。
examples.english: He violated the conditions of parole.

examples.japanese: {刑期|けいき}の{三分|さんぶん}の{二|に}を{終|お}えた{時点|じてん}で{仮釈放|かりしゃくほう}が{認|みと}められることがある。
examples.english: Parole may be granted after serving two-thirds of the sentence.

notes:
A compound of {仮|かり} (temporary, provisional) and {釈放|しゃくほう} (release, discharge). In the Japanese legal system, {仮釈放|かりしゃくほう} requires approval from the regional parole board and involves supervision by a probation officer during the remaining sentence period.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仮釈放|かりしゃくほう}される: to be released on parole
- {仮釈放|かりしゃくほう}を{認|みと}める: to grant parole
- {仮釈放|かりしゃくほう}の{条件|じょうけん}: conditions of parole
- {仮釈放|かりしゃくほう}{取|と}り{消|け}し: revocation of parole

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {釈放|しゃくほう}: release; discharge — unconditional release from custody
- {保釈|ほしゃく}: bail — release before trial upon payment of money
- {執行猶予|しっこうゆうよ}: suspended sentence — a sentence that is not carried out if the offender behaves well
